name: Sciatic Neuropathy
definition: Peripheral sciatic nerve lesion causing weakness and sensory loss across tibial and fibular divisions, distinguished from lumbosacral radiculopathy.

typical: Broad sensory deficit below knee depending on lesion

core: Hamstring, ankle and toe motor testing

investigations.MRI: MRI pelvis/hip/spine or nerve imaging is selected according to cause.

amber: Traumatic transection/compressive mass requires early specialist evaluation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gridhrasi-like phenotype may occur but nerve-level diagnosis must remain explicit.

patientEducation.summary: Peripheral sciatic nerve lesion causing weakness and sensory loss across tibial and fibular divisions, distinguished from lumbosacral radiculopathy.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
